item.name: type
item.label: Type
item.help: Product kind for this category. Other modules add options (e.g. Subscription) via panel extends.

item.name: product_type_id
item.label: Product type
item.help: Default for products in this category when product and subcategory have no type.

item.name: fulfilment
item.label: Fulfilment
item.help: How paid unfulfilled lines in this category are fulfilled. Empty: CMS does not fulfil. Skipped when Shopify status is in progress or fulfilled. Email: one message per recipient, containing only that recipient's lines.

item.name: fulfilment_emails
item.label: Fulfilment emails
item.help: Recipients for Email fulfilment. The same address on several categories gets one combined email per order.

item.name: collections
item.label: Collections
item.help: Collections listed under this category (mega menu columns by type). Shopify sync adds them when products in this category use them; editable in CMS.
